subject: Proposal: Availability guarantee + escalation retainer for Novapay
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novapay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Availability guarantee + escalation retainer for Novapay

Elena —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a concise proposal that lays out two availability tiers and an optional escalation retainer that gives you guaranteed on-call coverage and a named escalation path. High-level summary below:

- Bronze: 99.5% monthly uptime, standard support (email, business hours), SLA credit formula (pro-rata token credits).
- Silver: 99.9% monthly uptime, 24/7 monitoring + 8x5 rapid-response (2-hour response target), 25% faster triage for incidents; includes basic runbook integration.
- Gold (recommended): 99.95% monthly uptime, 24/7 coverage, 1-hour response target for Sev 1, named escalation engineer, quarterly review call. Includes escalation retainer (flat monthly fee) that provides guaranteed on-call rotation and incident war-room facilitation.

Pricing in the attached PDF is shown as list + committed discount for an annual prepay. My ask: review the Gold retainer scope (pages 2–3) and tell me whether Novapay prioritizes faster response (Gold) or lower unit costs (Bronze/Silver). If you want, we can do a hybrid: Silver with a smaller retainer that buys a single named escalation contact and 24/7 paging for Sev 1.

I cc'd Karthik to help model a concessions path if Novapay needs a larger discount or a trial period.

Attachments: 20260902-novapay-availability-offer.pdf (proposal), novapay-escalation-runbook-v1.docx (scope + sample runbook)

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm preferred tier and whether legal needs to see a term sheet before commercial numbers.
- Karthik: I'll sync if Novapay asks for staged commit pricing.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novapay.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Novapay Legal <legal@novapay.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Availability guarantee + escalation retainer for Novapay

Thanks, Dylan —

Appreciate the clear tiers. Quick reactions after an initial read:

- We like the Gold coverage for critical flows (payments settlement). The 1-hour response is compelling.
- Pricing looks a bit above our expectation given current annual run rate; can you show a stepped discount if we commit to 18 months and a modest growth clause?
- Can the retainer include a quarterly tabletop exercise (1x per quarter) as part of the runbook validation?

Legal: please review the sample runbook and flag anything that would materially slow negotiation.

Also, can you clarify the SLA credit calculation for partial-month outages? The PDF has the formula but I want an example with a 2-hour Sev1 outage in a 30-day month.

If you can get back with a priced 18-month concession and the tabletop included, I can push internally.

Best,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of Infrastructure & Ops
Novapay

Subject: Re: Proposal: Availability guarantee + escalation retainer for Novapay

Elena —

Thanks for the feedback. Answers inline and a revised price sheet attached.

- 18-month stepped discount: we can do a tiered concession model: 10% off list for 12-month; 15% off list for 18-month commit, with a growth corridor (+10% commit year 2) at the same price. Numbers are on the new sheet (see attachment: 20260903-novapay-price-update.pdf).
- Tabletop exercises: included in Gold at 1x/year by default; for Novapay we'll add quarterly tabletop exercises as part of the Gold retainer at no additional charge for the first 12 months (pilot concession).
- SLA credit example: imagine a single 2-hour Sev1 in a 30-day month. For Gold (99.95% target), monthly minutes = 30*24*60 = 43,200. Target uptime percentage maps to allowed downtime of ~21.6 minutes. A 2-hour outage (120 minutes) exceeds the allowance by 98.4 minutes. Our crediting formula would prorate token/usage credits based on the exceeded downtime bucket (see page 4 of the attached PDF). Roughly, that would result in X% credit on monthly invoice — the updated sheet has an example with the math.

I attached the updated price sheet and a redline of the runbook scope (small edits).

Attachments: 20260903-novapay-price-update.pdf, novapay-escalation-runbook-v1-redline.docx

If that looks workable, I can escalate to Marissa for approval on the 15% 18-month concession and we can prepare a short-term pilot signature.

Regards,
Dylan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Availability guarantee + escalation retainer for Novapay

Hi Elena —

I modeled a couple of concession paths and a minimal pilot alternative so we can get you coverage quickly without a full 18-month lock. Two options:

1) Pilot + upgrade: 6-month pilot at Gold coverage with 10% discount, quarterly tabletop included; if you convert to 18-month within pilot, apply the additional 5% backdated to the start.

2) Staged commit: 12-month at 12% discount + volume banding; add a $12k/month escalation retainer (waived first month) for named on-call and war-room facilitation.

Both paths keep the SLA math identical — credits are standard. I attached a one-page concession summary and a short runbook appendix for the pilot.

Marissa — tagging you for approval on offering the 15% for 18 months vs staged commit. If you approve, I'll draft the commercial term sheet and hand to legal.

Karthik
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: novapay-concession-summary-20260906.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novapay.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Availability guarantee + escalation retainer for Novapay

Hi team —

I've reviewed Karthik's concession scenarios and support the pilot path as our default play. Approve the following for commercial to send:

- Offer #1 (Pilot + upgrade): 6-month Gold pilot at 10% discount, quarterly tabletop for 6 months, retainer waived first month. Conversion to 18 months triggers retroactive 5% additional discount.
- Commit to named escalation engineer and a maximum of 12 hours/year of tabletop facilitation beyond the included sessions (anything above billed at T&M).

Rationale: this reduces our near-term discount exposure, gives Novapay confidence on operations, and preserves the 18-month upsell motion. If they push hard on price, escalate margin impact to me.

Elena — if that aligns, let us know and we'll spin the commercial term sheet + DocuSign for signature.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
